sections.appearance: She has a long straight navy blue hair tied in long pigtails wrapped in orange bandana for cooking safety. She has goat horns and red eyes. The ends of the hair were dyed a light blue. Casual: She let her long hair fall down to her thighs, Her small locks of hair were secured to either side by her goat horns. The color remains unchanged. Halo ==== Fuuka's halo is red and is shaped as an [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Onigiri Onigiri] inside a large diamond star. Two small diamonds rest separately on each of its front sides. Uniform ==== She wears a navy blue one-piece pleated dress with red and yellow stripes, red and orange tie, and white apron with pink belt. She also wears red socks underneath her white sneakers with navy decoration. Casual: She was wearing a light blue V-neck pinafore dress. Inside, there was a white T-shirt and a small gold heart-shaped necklace. She wore white socks and Mary Jane shoes. She was also wearing a white beret. And a watch. Firearm ==== thumb|School Lunch Club Self-defense Weapon Type A|150px She uses a black H&K MP7 submachine gun with a white handguard and a red collapsing stock. It is equipped with an Aimpoint Micro T1 Reflex Sight.

sections.personality: She tends to care a lot for Sensei, making sure they don't eat too many unhealthy foods and asking them to call her if they ever need a meal prepared.
